data.rationale: The proposal captures the right procedure and email template in roughly the right order, but it omits the blog URL as a parameter (it says to find the post via the profile's website link), makes the recipient a parameter when it is fixed, leaves "Send, or discard" ambiguous when the true workflow requires Discard, and doesn't mention the new tab or the Mail tab switch, which makes it less automatable.
